title: A Wild Instinct Still Living in Your Dog
description:
Have you ever seen your dog bury their food and wondered why? 🐶
It may look funny, but it’s actually a powerful survival instinct passed down from their wild ancestors.

In the wild, hiding extra food meant protection and security for later.
Even though your dog now lives a safe and comfortable life, that instinct is still deeply rooted inside them.

It’s not strange behavior — it’s nature at work.
